name: 46517 · Elkhart, IN
findings: ZIP 46517 (Elkhart) has 64 nonprofit organizations. 20 of them (31%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 14 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (53% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 46517 (Elkhart) has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in ZIP 46517 (Elkhart) list membership in their tax returns or on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 68% of the typical level).
